safe_area.reason: Feed interfaces overlay account headers, captions and action controls near the edges, and the lower band is the most frequently obscured. Anything load-bearing placed outside this area risks being cropped or covered depending on the client application.

structural_rules.focal_requirement: One unambiguous focal element that resolves at thumbnail size. The asset is first seen at roughly a tenth of its rendered dimensions while scrolling, so anything that depends on reading two competing elements will fail before it is ever opened.
